[LTIM.8.2.1] The runtime registers exactly the following **fixed** v1
format identifiers (**no** `rfc3339` / `rfc2822` /
named or adapter-registered formats):

| Identifier | Written as |
|---|---|
| `"iso8601"` (the cast form, [LCST.4.5.9]) | `"2024-01-15T08:00:00-08:00"` for `Time`; `"2024-01-15"` for `Date` |
| `"epoch_seconds"` | `"1705334400"` (`Time` only) |
| `"epoch_millis"` | `"1705334400000"` (`Time` only) |
| `"epoch_micros"` | `"1705334400000000"` (`Time` only) |
| `"epoch_nanos"` | `"1705334400000000000"` (`Time` only); the full `Time.utc_ns`, exact |

The `iso8601` text is [LTIM.8.2.3]'s grammar, written as [LTIM.8.2.4] states.
The identifiers name output forms only: no format is read ([LTIM.14]).
